aesthetic: Meridian Editorial — a warm-press magazine system where right-anchored type floats against breathing cream fields, disciplined by Swiss grid logic but warmed by analogue paper tones
chromaticArc: Slides 1–12 are grounded in Antique Paper with Burnished Gold accents to evoke a warm editorial opening; slides 13–26 cool progressively as Steel Mist enters the body zones and accent bars; slides 27–38 shift toward Twilight Ink tinting borders and secondary text; slides 39–40 close on two Twilight Ink dark dividers, completing the golden-to-deep-blue arc with exactly three light-to-dark crossings.
gridStrategy: The dominant mode is right-anchored: titles sit at col 30–50 with the left half breathing; every 5–6 slides a full-width or centred composition resets rhythm, and section dividers flip to a left-sidebar layout (title col 0 span 18, body col 22 span 36) to mark transitions.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia appears on 6 slides (approx. 15%): the 3 warm-gold editorial opening slides and 3 reflective closing slides where the analogue warmth of serif type echoes the paper ground

accentStrategy: Thin single-column vertical bars (span 1, height 6–10 rows) in Burnished Gold or Steel Mist act as zone dividers or marginal punctuation on 18 of the 40 slides; 4 slides additionally use a full-width hairline rule (type: line, row height 1) to cleave title from body with Swiss precision.
